Big Tech AI Investment to Exceed $1 Trillion by 2027, Says UBS

Big Tech companies are projected to invest over $1 trillion in Artificial Intelligence (AI) infrastructure by 2027, driven by escalating demand, according to a UBS report. This substantial investment is expected to boost the US economy, potentially increasing GDP growth by approximately 0.75 percentage points. However, companies are facing challenges with increasing cash flow.
